title: Even Squares and Odd Count
statement: You are given n integers. Add up the squares of all the even numbers. Also count how many numbers are odd. Print the sum of squares on the first line. Print the odd count on the second line. Zero is even. Negative numbers can be even or odd too. Use STL algorithms with lambdas.
inputFormat: First line: integer n. Second line: n integers separated by spaces.
outputFormat: Line 1: the sum of squares of the even numbers. Line 2: the count of odd numbers.
constraints: The sum can be larger than 32-bit int; use long long
explanations: Even numbers are 2 and 4. Their squares are 4 and 16, which add to 20. The odd numbers are 1, 3 and 5, so the count is 3.
Even numbers are -2, 0 and 10. Squares are 4, 0 and 100, so the sum is 104. Only 7 is odd. A negative even number gives a positive square.
reference:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(data[0])
a = [int(x) for x in data[1:1 + n]]
print(sum(x * x for x in a if x % 2 == 0))
print(sum(1 for x in a if x % 2 != 0))
